Wish.title: Wish
Wish.description: A 20/11 Teacher's Day tribute wish written for any teacher at Trường THPT Nguyễn Trãi.

teacherName.description: Name of the teacher receiving the tribute (entered by the student).

senderName.description: Display name of the student or class sending the wish.

imageDataUrl.description: Optional compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP base64 data URL attached to the wish.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

isPublic.description: Visibility flag for public tribute wall display.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the wish was created.

FlowerOffering.title: FlowerOffering
FlowerOffering.description: A flower offering sent to teachers' bouquet or to a specific wish.

userId.description: UID of the student offering the flower.

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag for bouquet counter.

/wishes/{wishId}.description: Public tribute wall wishes addressed to teachers chosen by students.

/wishes/{wishId}/flowers/{userId}.description: Per-user flower reactions on a specific wish.

/bouquetFlowers/{userId}.description: Per-user flower offerings for the school's 20/11 bouquet.
